t: EMQQ Global on emerging markets and the AI opportunity
desc: Kevin Carter, Founder and Chief Investment Officer of EMQQ Global and the INQQ Fund joined Steve Darling from Proactive about the impact of artificial intelligence on emerging markets, the dominance of the AI “Mag Three” and investment opportunities across the emerging market internet sector. Carter highlighted Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Samsung and SK Hynix as the leading beneficiaries of AI infrastructure spending, describing the semiconductor companies as the “picks and shovels” leaders of the AI buildout. He noted that these three companies have accounted for approximately 90% of emerging market index returns this year, highlighting their profitability amid continued investment in AI infrastructure. Carter also discussed the competition between the United States and China across five key layers of artificial intelligence: power, semiconductors, data centres, large language models and applications. He highlighted China's electricity capacity, the adoption of Chinese open AI models and their cost advantages. Turning to investment opportunities, Carter discussed the attractive valuations of emerging market internet companies, highlighting Tencent and MercadoLibre as businesses well positioned to deploy AI through their established digital platforms and extensive customer data. He also highlighted India's long-term digital growth opportunity, driven by smartphone adoption, increasing internet access and strong earnings growth.
